definition.simple: When two or more different elements hold hands tightly to become something completely new.
definition.academic: A substance formed when two or more chemical elements are chemically bonded together in a fixed ratio.

common_misconceptions: Believing compounds retain the properties of their constituent elements (e.g., thinking water is explosive because it has hydrogen).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Remind them about water. Hydrogen is explosive, Oxygen fuels fire. But Water extinguishes fire! The properties completely change.
